systemctl.description: Control the systemd system and service manager.

fields.label: Action
fields.tooltip:
The action to perform on the service.
- start/stop: For the current session.
- enable/disable: To start on boot.
Conflicts with 'List all unit files'.

fields.label: Service Name
fields.tooltip: The name of the service (e.g., sshd, nginx, docker).

fields.label: List all unit files
fields.tooltip:
Show all installed service files and their status.
Conflicts with 'Action'.

fields.label: User services (--user)
fields.tooltip:
Manage services for your user, not the system.
Conflicts with 'sudo'.

journalctl.description: Query the systemd journal (view system logs).

fields.label: Follow (like tail -f)
fields.tooltip: Follow the journal live. Conflicts with time ranges (Since/Until).

fields.label: Filter by Unit/Service
fields.tooltip: Show logs for a specific service (e.g., sshd).

fields.label: Lines to show
fields.tooltip: Show the last N lines (e.g., 20). Default is 10.

fields.label: Since
fields.tooltip: Show logs since a time (e.g., '1h ago', '2025-11-06'). Conflicts with Follow.

fields.label: Until
fields.tooltip: Show logs until a time (e.g., 'now', '10min ago'). Conflicts with Follow.
